title: Meta and Apple team up to make Muse AI models run better on Macs
slides: Meta and Apple just partnered—who really wins?
Muse AI models will run natively on Macs
But Apple gets a cut from Meta's models
Your Mac apps could get free AI upgrades soon
Check if your favorite app supports Muse next week
thread_text:
1. Meta vs Apple: Who Wins?

Meta's Muse AI models will run natively on Macs, but Apple takes a cut from every use.

2. Apple's Cut Changes Game

Meta pays Apple a commission on Muse model usage, shifting the economics of free AI.

3. Free AI for Mac Apps

Your favorite Mac apps could get free AI upgrades soon, thanks to this partnership.

4. Check App Support Next Week

See if your go-to app supports Muse—if not, ask the developer when it will.

5. Test It Yourself

Download a Muse-powered app and see if the free upgrade saves you time or adds hassle.

instagram.caption:
Meta's Muse AI models will run natively on Macs, but Apple takes a cut every time they're used.

That means Meta pays Apple a commission on Muse usage—so "free" AI on your Mac isn't actually free for Meta. 🍎

The upside: your favorite Mac apps could get AI upgrades without you paying extra. 🤖

If you build or publish with Mac tools, watch for Muse support landing in your apps next week. ✍️

Check if your go-to app is on the list. If it's not, will you ask the developer when it's coming? 👀
